item.title: My research
item.description:
Research interests: univariate and multivariate extreme value theory, environmental data analysis, Bayesian methods, machine learning for extremes.

Ongoing projects:

  • Simulation and probabilistic analysis of complex extreme events with applications to compound climate extremes in agronomy and ecology. With Freddy Bouchet, Aurélie Fischer, Thomas Opitz and Pascal Yiou.

Recent preprints:

  • Carcaiso, V., de Carvalho, M., Prosdocimi, I., Antoniano-Villalobos, I. (2025). Bayesian mixture models for heterogeneous extremes. arXiv:2509.15359
  • Carcaiso, V., Engelke, S., Legrand, J., Opitz, T. (2026) Extrapolation of extreme covariates in generalized additive regression using extreme-value theory. arXiv:2607.08921
